verdict.rationale: Apify's Actor model supports passing large lists of startUrls with concurrency controls (e.g. maxCrawlPages), proxy rotation to avoid blocking at scale, and JS/Python clients with async/await and streaming support for handling long-running batch jobs, plus webhooks to chain runs. This directly matches asynchronous batch scraping of many URLs. Missing for 10: concrete benchmarks or documented concurrency/throughput limits for 'thousands of URLs', and independent hands-on confirmation of large-scale batch runs.
